taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-16 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 312.0 | 6.08 | 6.08
2 | 794.3 | 14.76 | 20.84
3 | 884.4 | 3.48 | 24.32
4 | 1280.2 | 10.95 | 35.27
5 | 4929.0 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as H-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-16
Curve type: H-type
Aquifer depth: 6.08 m – 35.27 m
Recommendation: Target the weathered/fractured horizon (Layers 2–4, 794–1280 ohm-m) between 6.08 m and 35.27 m depth as the main water-bearing zone; case off the shallow overburden (0–6.08 m) and terminate drilling once the highly resistive basement (4929 ohm-m) is encountered near 35.3 m, as it is likely tight/unweathered and unproductive.
